featured_reviews.name: Hitanshi Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience. Super average dances - unrealistic rules- songs will be edited and then no changes can be done whatsoever, songs are edited as per Mr Sachin’s wishes- how on earth is that valid?
Super rude behaviour by Mr Sachin towards all my guests and even my parents. Not accommodating towards any changes whatsoever, did not take any feedback, below average dance and over all that all he tried to do was upsell - if you had put such effort in the dance rather than upselling then it would’ve resulted in a better sangeet!
Even the couple dance was below average- super disappointed. Please avoid at all costs if you want your sangeet to go well and need wow factors in your dances. Or be ready to shed around 40-50k for the wow factor for a 2 min dance!
My In laws got their dance choreographed from someone else and that lady charged less than half of what Sachin did and she put 10000-% effort with edits, steps, props, wow factor without charging exorbitant amounts.
To top it off, he asked money for a 45 sec song which I got added in my couple dance saying it will be treated as a separate act.
This was never communicated to me ever! How unprofessional is this? And when I denied giving money he did not send me any of the song edits.
Just too much drama 3 days before my function. Please avoid at all costs.

featured_reviews.review_text: It has been a pleasure having Jyoti Ma’am as a teacher and mentor. She knows how to strike a perfect balance between a taskmaster and good company. featured_reviews.review_text:
I came all the way from Korea and had such an amazing experience here. From the moment I arrived, everyone was incredibly kind, welcoming, and friendly.

As someone who had very little experience with Bollywood dance, I was a bit nervous at first, but the instructor made me feel comfortable right away. The choreography was broken down step by step in a way that was easy to understand, and the teaching style was patient, encouraging, and fun throughout the entire lesson.

What impressed me the most was how passionate and energetic the instructor was. The class never felt intimidating, and I found myself enjoying every minute while learning something completely new. Even as a beginner, I was able to follow along and gain confidence by the end of the session.

I was also filming a travel vlog during my visit, and they were very accommodating and supportive. The atmosphere was positive, professional, and full of good energy.

This has been one of the most memorable experiences of my trip to India. If you’re visiting Mumbai and want to experience authentic Bollywood dance, I highly recommend taking a class here. Thank you for making my time in India so special. I will definitely remember this experience and hope to come back again in the future!

featured_reviews.name: Tushar Karpe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I feel truly grateful to be a part of the Kathak class conducted by Guru Nrityalankar Madhuri Karpe. This class is not just about learning dance steps, but about understanding the soul, discipline, and depth of Kathak as a classical art form. Guruji’s teaching style is extremely graceful, patient, and inspiring. She gives personal attention to every student and ensures that each movement, expression, and rhythm is clearly understood.
What makes this class special is the perfect balance between tradition and structured learning. Guru Madhuri Karpe has profound knowledge of Kathak and conveys it with great clarity and passion. The atmosphere of the class is very positive, peaceful, and motivating, which helps students grow not only as dancers but also as confident individuals.
Regular practice, detailed guidance, and emphasis on expressions (abhinaya), footwork (tatkar), and rhythm (taal) make the learning experience enriching and enjoyable. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced learner, this class helps you evolve artistically.
I would highly recommend this Kathak class to anyone who truly wishes to learn and experience authentic Kathak under expert guidance. It is a wonderful place to learn, grow, and connect with Indian classical dance.

featured_reviews.name: Meenal Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We discovered Cheerful Mind Academy (CMA)while looking for a preschool near us and enrolled Nurvi in Playgroup and Nursery after being impressed by their curriculum and activity plan. Watching her grow since then has been a joy.

Principal Mrs. Madhavi Morjaria is a gem—she guided us patiently through the entire journey. The teachers and staff are warm and attentive; they notice each child’s strengths and gently work on their weaker spots, bringing everyone forward together. We always got clear updates on class activities, and the coordination with parents felt effortless.

The staff are vigilant and the pickup/ drop protocols are strict without being stressful. The meal timetable is thoughtful and encourages kids to have healthy options.

The year-round activities, competitions, and field trips are creative and genuinely informative. Sports Day and the Annual Day are exceptionally well organised. Most of all, CMA encourages every child and helps them shine.

Thank you, Madhavi ma’am, Dharmesh sir, Harsh sir, and the whole CMA team—you’ve helped Nurvi grow in confidence and curiosity.
